description: This file defines the UniqueId entity class for use with Doctrine ORM, representing a database table 'hs_hr_unique_id' that stores unique identifier information with properties like id, lastId, tableName, and fieldName. It includes getter and setter methods for each property.

classes.name: UniqueId
classes.description: Entity class mapped to 'hs_hr_unique_id' table, holding unique ID generation data such as last used ID, table name, and field name.

methods.name: setId

methods.name: setLastId
